plugins.name: chorus
plugins.description: Local TTS-only companion for Claude Code, Codex, and Grok on Apple Silicon Macs via MCP speak.
plugins.installation: Build and run `chorus install --claude` (or full install). Restart Claude Code so MCP tool speak / mcp__chorus__speak appears. Use skill chorus-speak at turn end.
plugins.privacy: Speaks only agent-provided text through the local menu-bar daemon. No STT, no cloud summarization, no transcript upload.
